definitions.natural: argsort(diag H, descending) inside the solver (historical); reused after bitwise re-solve parity
definitions.fixed: actorder_override = the ORIGINAL configuration's natural permutation for that projection (computed from the ORIGINAL Hessian); grouping Hessians, scales, zero-points, error feedback stay live. Cost: requires the reference calibration execution (one extra Hessian pass + argsort) and storage of 12 permutations; NOT reference-free
definitions.bucketed: actorder_override = moe_calib.actorder_policy.bucketed_perm(own H, bits): float64 frexp mantissa truncated to bits significant bits (floor), descending key, ties by ascending column index (numpy stable argsort, CPU); primary bits = 8 (frozen after inspecting diag(H) only: logs/audit.json diag_inspection), exploratory [6, 10]; fixed power-of-two boundaries independent of observed min/max; reference-free
definitions.disabled: gptq_quantize(actorder=False): original column order, groups = consecutive original columns
